gloss: in one go; all at once

definitions.gloss: in one go; all at once; without stopping
definitions.explanation: Describes completing an action rapidly and without pause or interruption. Emphasizes speed and continuity.
Describes a sudden, large-scale change in a situation or condition.

examples.japanese: ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{一気|いっき}に⟦{飲|の}んだ→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
examples.english: I drank the water in one gulp.

examples.japanese: ⟦{宿題|しゅくだい}→宿題：00812_shukudai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{一気|いっき}に⟦{片付|かたづ}けた→片付ける：01192_katazukeru⟧。
examples.english: I finished my homework in one go.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{面白|おもしろ}くて→面白い：00589_omoshiroi⟧、{一気|いっき}に⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{読|よ}んで→読む：00426_yomu⟧しまった。
examples.english: This novel was so interesting that I read it all the way through without stopping.

examples.japanese: ⟦{気温|きおん}→気温：00235_kion⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一気|いっき}に⟦{下|さ}がった→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧。
⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{咲|さ}いて→咲く：08150_saku⟧、⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一気|いっき}に⟦{華|はな}やか→華やか：06070_hanayaka⟧になった。
examples.english: The cherry blossoms bloomed and the town became vibrant all at once.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦ニュース→ニュース：04437_nyuusu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{株価|かぶか}→株価：05154_kabuka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一気|いっき}に⟦{上昇|じょうしょう}した→上昇する：21681_joushousuru⟧。
examples.english: Stock prices surged dramatically on that news.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 1 focuses on doing something without interruption — drinking, reading, climbing, etc. Sense 2 describes a rapid, dramatic change in conditions like temperature, mood, or prices. Both senses share the core idea of something happening swiftly and completely.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一気|いっき}に⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧ (to drink in one gulp)
- {一気|いっき}に⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧ (to read in one sitting)
- {一気|いっき}に⟦{片付|かたづ}ける→片付ける：01192_katazukeru⟧ (to finish in one go)
- {一気|いっき}に{加速|かそく}する (to accelerate rapidly)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- いっぺん⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: all at once — emphasizes doing multiple things simultaneously rather than speed
- ⟦{一挙|いっきょ}→一挙：11234_ikkyo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: in one stroke — more formal, often used for decisive actions
